title: Prometheus plumbing: prompt/ingest/history-index subcommands, evolve --only, risk-aware ordering, needs-human queue (MANUAL APPLY)
description: Additive edit to the self-protected engine, applied manually in a supervised session (precedent: PROM-067 applied-manual). (1) Extract cmd_scan's per-item persist block into persist_scan_items() with per-item try/except hardening. (2) `prompt --category <c>`: print build_scan_prompt to stdout so workflow scanners single-source the prompt. (3) `ingest <file.json> --category <c> [--dry-run]`: validate a proposal JSON array through the identical sanitize/self-protection/score-clamp/low-value machinery plus fuzzy-title dedup (difflib ratio >0.75) against applied/rejected/pending, rejecting with 'duplicate of PROM-XXX'; serial invocation keeps next_proposal_id and ledger append race-free. (4) `history-index`: compact JSON digest of all proposals for scanner dedup-context injection. (5) `evolve --only PROM-NNN`: apply one named proposal through the unchanged snapshot/py_compile/checksum/rollback pipeline; add json.loads validation for .json targets and `bash -n` for .sh targets; change evolve ordering from impact DESC to (impact - risk/2). (6) Route proposals targeting SELF_PROTECTED_FILES to new .cto/prometheus/needs-human/ with status human-review, surfaced in cmd_status, instead of silent rejection.
proposed_changes: See description. Legacy scan/evolve behavior otherwise byte-for-byte unchanged. Verify: py_compile, scan --dry-run, status, ingest --dry-run smoke test.
